If you mean **which stocks are worth researching right now**, the most current “buy” lists in the results point to a mix of **value**, **energy**, **insurance**, and **high-growth tech** names rather than one single best stock.[1][4][6]

Here are the names most clearly surfaced by the results:

- **Mercury General (MCY)** — Zacks highlights it as one of its best stocks to buy now, with a forward P/E of **8.92** and projected 1-year EPS growth of **43.99%**.[1]
- **Marathon Petroleum (MPC)** — also on Zacks’ list, with forward P/E **8.72** and projected 1-year EPS growth of **180.80%**.[1]
- **Teekay Tankers (TNK)** — Zacks lists it as a top pick, with forward P/E **5.25** and projected 1-year EPS growth of **97.56%**.[1]
- **Diversified Energy Company (DEC)** — another Zacks pick, but its projected sales and EPS growth are negative in the table, so this is a more contrarian/value-style idea.[1]
- **Sandisk (SNDK)** — Bankrate lists it among the best-performing S&P 500 stocks in 2026 so far, with year-to-date performance of **172.8%**.[4]
- **Texas Pacific Land (TPL)** — Bankrate’s list shows year-to-date performance of **75.8%**.[4]
- **Campbell’s (CPB), SAP, Zoetis (ZTS), Broadridge Financial Solutions (BR), RELX, Yum China (YUMC), and Clorox (CLX)** — Morningstar includes these among its “10 best companies to invest in now,” focusing on durable businesses.[6]

A different source emphasizes longer-term compounders such as **Enterprise Products Partners (EPD)**, **Brookfield Corporation (BN)**, **MicroStrategy (MSTR)**, **HDFC Bank (HDB)**, and **Canadian Natural Resources (CNQ)** as stocks to buy and hold for the next decade.[3]

If you want a practical shortlist, I’d split it like this based on the sources:
- **Value/safer earnings**: MCY, MPC, TNK[1]
- **Momentum winners**: SNDK, TPL, GNRC, GLW, TER, WDC[4]
- **Defensive quality**: CPB, ZTS, BR, RELX, CLX[6]
- **Long-term income/compounders**: EPD, BN, HDB, CNQ[3]

If you want, I can turn this into a **3-stock buy list by risk level**: conservative, balanced, or aggressive.
